dg-APL-207099.title: Red Sea Nutrients Control Pro Multi Test Kit (NO3/PO4)
dg-APL-207099.summary: High-accuracy color-comparator tests for nitrate and phosphate, the two nutrients reef keepers track to control algae and keep corals growing and colored.
rows: Color change read against the included color disk/card
inBox: NO3 reagents A (25 ml), B (20 g), C (20 g)
PO4 reagents A (50 ml), B (15 ml)
notes: Too much nitrate or phosphate feeds nuisance algae. Too little can hold back coral growth and color. Testing regularly lets you spot the trend.

dg-APL-210927.title: Aquaforest AF Magnesium Test Kit

dg-APL-250164.title: API Reef Master Test Kit

Information on how to correct unsafe water conditions

dg-APL-256990.title: Neptune Systems Trident ACM Alkalinity, Calcium & Magnesium Tester (without reagents)
dg-APL-256990.summary: Neptune's Trident ACM, an automatic tester that runs alkalinity, calcium and magnesium tests on a schedule (up to 24 a day), logs and graphs them in Apex Fusion, alerts you and can steer a DOS doser. Needs an Apex; sold without reagents.

Less than 4 ft above the water source
A3 Apex (Pro, Apex, Jr.) or A2 Apex (Apex, EL); open 1Link port or 24 V supply
notes: An A3 Apex Jr. also needs a 36 W 24 V DC power supply and AquaBus cable.

A3 Apex (Pro, Apex, Jr.) or A2 Apex (Apex, EL)
